Copy provider_id={{PROVIDER_ID}}, model_id={{MODEL_ID}}, request_id={{REQUEST_ID}}, and envelope_id={{ENVELOPE_ID}} exactly. Write only {{OUTPUT_ENVELOPE}} as provider-protocol.v1 JSON; do not alter or reseal the packet.
